description: Verify an asset/record or retrieve and validate a PrivateDAO receipt. Returns structured evidence and hashes; it is free and read-only, never pays or executes work, and replaces the separate basic, receipt, and get-receipt paths.

inputSchema.description: Perform read-only verification or receipt retrieval. Use this instead of separate basic, receipt, and get-receipt tools; it never pays or executes a job.

expected_digest.description: Optional digest that must match the canonical verified record.

expected_hash.description: Optional result hash that must match the receipt evidence.

mode.description: Use basic for an asset/record check or receipt for an existing receipt.

network.description: Optional network identifier for the asset or receipt evidence.

receipt.description: Receipt returned by a completed job.

receipt_id.description: Receipt identifier to retrieve and verify.

name: verify_receipt

outputSchema.description: Read-only verification evidence or a public receipt.

verification_status.description: Verification result when evidence is accepted.

title: PrivateDAO Receipt Verification
